name: Novabase S.G.P.S., S.A.
summary: Novabase S.G.P.S., S.A., through its subsidiaries, provides various business solutions in Portugal, Europe, Africa, and the Middle East. It offers technology, management, design, and business expertise services, as well as engages in venture capital activities. The company also provides financial services through Wizzio, a digital platform; Symetria, a platform for regulatory reporting and risk management; Binfolio for valuation, accounting, and reporting processes; and Rely to control the full finance lifecycle for factoring, payables finance, and leasing businesses. In addition, it offers budget and healthcare insight, and Novabase innercase solutions. The company serves banks, insurance, capital markets, and telecommunication sectors. Novabase S.G.P.S., S.A. was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Lisbon, Portugal.
